purpose: Prevent silent partial Fathom destination completion, recording-ID collisions and incomplete-listing watermark loss during local V2 migration; preserve bounded polling and durable query boundaries.
origin: V2-authored correction; immutable preserved source and active installation remain unchanged.
limitations: POSIX local poll ownership uses one state-file lock; independent direct/webhook writers require separate operational exclusion.
No automatic reconciliation or retry of uncertain journal delivery; existing notes alone do not prove journal delivery.
Local receipt checks preserve editable notes; existence is not immutable content or external receipt verification.
A truncated page budget fails without advancing the watermark; a larger explicitly bounded catch-up may require operator action. No persistent cursor framework is introduced.
Synthetic Fathom/journal boundaries do not prove live provider authentication or delivery.
No installation, scheduler activation, publication or V1 retirement permission is conferred.

verification.source: 83 focused Fathom cases passed with independent review; targeted Ruff passed.
verification.installed: 201 combined isolated installed cases passed, including 24 pagination cases; synthetic discovery and journal boundaries, not production acceptance.
